title: claytonia perfoliata subsp. mexicana
intro: Claytonia perfoliata subsp. mexicana, commonly known as Mexican Miner's Lettuce or Mexican Spring Beauty, is a subspecies of the plant species Claytonia perfoliata, belonging to the family Portulacaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Claytonia perfoliata subsp. mexicana are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include vitamins A, C, and E, as well as minerals such as calcium, iron, and potassium, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
